scope: Dates, times, case labels, notes, sources, TSVs and post bodies are unchanged. Case matches use reviewed victim/defendant identities; historical roundups are explicitly labeled background. Archived posts are inventoried but not newly promoted. General process explainers without a case identity remain in the inventory, not attached to unrelated cases.
warnings: Public /products, /store and /shop indexes return 404; source-linked product URLs plus the live Beehiiv sitemap supplied the complete discovered inventory.
The Eric Richins paid guide has no matching current calendar entry, so no unrelated case was linked.
The generic no-body, jury and forensic explainers are not assigned to cases merely because they share a legal topic.
Separate WSU civil, Colin Gray prosecution, Bobby Lee Hart prosecution, Sophia Sullivan investigation and Fernandez Saldana molestation matters are not conflated with other cases.
